commits.subject: Merge pull request #679 from chowette/fix-gdiplus-emf-world-transform
commits.body: gdiplus: fixed EMF conversion of world transforms and extended pens
commits.author: ab

commits.subject: gdiplus: EMR_MODIFYWORLDTRANSFORM support in EMF conversion
commits.body: EMR_MODIFYWORLDTRANSFORM was ignored. TeeChart draws its lines in 1/16 pixel units set by this record, so they were drawn 16 times too large by the anti-aliased TGDIPages preview. All the modes are now handled with the CombineTransform() API. FPC declares it with a pointer and var parameters, so a proxy with the Delphi signature is defined for FPC only.
commits.author: chowette

commits.subject: gdiplus: keep the EMF world transform in the DC state
commits.body: EMR_SETWORLDTRANSFORM was applied once, and lost at the next RestoreDC or window/viewport change, e.g. when a metafile is nested in another one. The transform is now stored in each DC state, restored by RestoreDC, and combined with the window/viewport matrix by ScaleMatrix(), which does not need a parameter any more.
commits.author: chowette

commits.subject: gdiplus: EMR_EXTCREATEPEN support in EMF conversion
commits.body: Extended pens, as created e.g. by TeeChart for its lines, were ignored: no GDI+ pen was created for the handle, so lines were drawn with the previously selected pen. They are now created from the color, width and dash style of the extended pen. This is an approximation: end caps, joins and brush styles are not handled.
commits.author: chowette

commits.subject: gdiplus: fixed sign extension of 16-bit points in EMF conversion
commits.body: The points of EMR_POLYGON16, EMR_POLYLINE16 and EMR_POLYBEZIER16 are signed 16-bit values. Points16To32() copied them as words, so a negative coordinate like -8 became 65528.
commits.author: chowette
